headline: Rochem Separation Systems secures Rs 14.25 crore order for water treatment systems
hook: New water treatment orders in Hyderabad
summary: Rochem Separation Systems (India) Private Limited, a material wholly owned subsidiary of Cambridge Technology Enterprises, has received orders totaling Rs 14.25 crore. The contract involves the supply, installation, and commissioning of advanced water and wastewater treatment systems at a Hyderabad facility for a leading Solar PV modules manufacturer. This order adds to the subsidiary's operational pipeline in the industrial wastewater segment.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary order inflow supports subsidiary revenue growth.
